body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Radiant Damage and suppress one ordinary magical Movement bonus on it until the start of your next turn, up to 1 unit.

surges.html: A willing ally adjacent to it may move 1 unit away.
After a hit, end the suppressed bonus if the target is a manifestation or temporary magical construct.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Beast
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Beast Full Manifestation (FM-1B). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
